extraction_notes: Only the main article text/images were provided; Supplementary Tables/Figures containing laboratory packed-bed results, higher dopant loadings, and detailed supplementary performance data were not available for extraction. Dense time-series plots in Figures 4a, 5b, and 6a were not digitized point-by-point; exact performance values printed in the text were extracted. CO2-free H2/N2 treatments, CO2 pulse/TPR experiments, DRUVS/Raman diagnostic runs without quantitative methanol performance, and DFT data were excluded as non-catalytic-performance records for CO2-to-methanol.
